name: Picmaker
description_en:
Picmaker combines template-based graphics with AI design suggestions and plan-dependent social media management. Its current pricing distinguishes Create features from Manage and Market modules, which are shown as Teams-only. A low-price design subscription should not be assumed to include the full scheduling, inbox, analytics and reporting suite.

It fits creators and marketing teams preparing branded social assets and, under the appropriate plan, moving them into a social calendar. Free access, watermark-free downloads, premium stock credits, file formats and third-party content rights have different limits. The visible browser pricing was used instead of the page’s hidden mixed-product upgrade dialogs.
description_zh:
Picmaker 把模板图形、AI设计建议及按套餐提供的社交媒体管理组合在一起。当前价格区分 Create 与 Manage/Market 模块，后两者标为Teams专属。不能假定低价设计订阅包含完整排程、收件箱、分析及报表。

它适合创作者及营销团队制作品牌社交素材，并在合适套餐下进入社交日历。免费访问、无水印下载、高级图库点数、格式及第三方内容权利有不同限制。本文采用浏览器实际可见价格，未采用HTML中混杂其他产品的隐藏升级弹窗。

core_features.explanation_en: Create assets using templates, brand kits, background removal, resizing and plan-scoped AI suggestions.
core_features.explanation_zh: 利用模板、品牌工具包、背景移除、改尺寸及按方案提供的AI建议制作素材。

core_features.explanation_zh: 当前价格把Manage和Market标为仅Teams可用，需区别旧的宽泛介绍。

core_features.explanation_en: JPEG/PNG/PDF, watermark allowances, stock credits and storage differ by plan; listed coming-soon formats are not shipped features.
core_features.explanation_zh: JPEG/PNG/PDF、水印额度、图库点数及存储按方案不同，标记Coming Soon的格式不当已发布功能。

sections.title_en: Separate design creation from publishing and monitoring
sections.title_zh: 区分设计制作、发布与监测
sections.en:
The browser pricing page presents Picmaker Create for graphics and lists Manage (scheduling/conversations) and Market (analytics/reporting) as Teams-only. Starter focuses on premium design tools, brand kits, folders and downloads; Pro adds more storage, multiple brand kits and unlimited AI design suggestions. Teams is quoted and advertises the social toolkit, analytics/reporting and AI inbox. These plan boundaries are more specific than a homepage claim that one platform handles all social work.

Editorial example: a solo designer makes a recurring post series with shared colors and fonts, then downloads assets for an existing publishing tool. A team wanting scheduling plus inbox and reports should obtain the Teams scope and connected-network permissions first. Animaker is the related maker, but its character/video/export packages appearing in hidden HTML are not Picmaker entitlements.
sections.zh:
浏览器价格页将Picmaker Create用于图形，把Manage（排程/对话）和Market（分析/报表）标为Teams专属。Starter侧重高级设计工具、品牌工具包、文件夹和下载；Pro增加存储、多品牌及无限AI设计建议；Teams询价并宣传社交工具、分析/报表和AI收件箱。这些边界比“一个平台处理所有社交工作”的首页表述更具体。

编辑示例：独立设计师用统一颜色/字体做系列帖子，下载后交给已有发布工具。团队若需要排程、收件箱及报表，应先取得Teams范围及所需网络权限。Animaker是关联厂商，但隐藏HTML中的人物/视频/导出套餐不是Picmaker权益。

sections.title_en: Create the asset, then enter an eligible scheduler
sections.title_zh: 先制作素材，再进入有权限的排程
sections.en:
A documentation-based workflow is to choose a design/template, edit text and uploaded assets, apply brand styling and inspect the intended dimensions. Download the appropriate format or, where the plan permits, proceed to scheduling. The [scheduler guide](https://support.picmaker.com/en/articles/7992903-how-to-access-picmaker-s-social-scheduler) says it is reached from Dashboard → Social Scheduler or the editor’s upper-right Schedule button after designing. It then allows connecting social accounts and planning posts.

That guide was written in 2023 and explains navigation, not current paid entitlement; the current Teams-only module labels still apply. Verify the target network/account type, authorization and media rules, preview the caption/crop and confirm a live post after its scheduled time. An item in a calendar is not evidence of external publication. No account was connected and no post or draft was submitted for this research.
sections.zh:
基于文档的流程是选择设计/模板，修改文字和上传素材，应用品牌样式并检查目标尺寸，再下载合适格式，或在套餐允许时进入排程。[排程指南](https://support.picmaker.com/en/articles/7992903-how-to-access-picmaker-s-social-scheduler)说明可从Dashboard → Social Scheduler，或完成设计后点编辑器右上Schedule进入，再连接社交账户及安排帖子。

该指南写于2023年，说明导航而非当前付费资格，仍需采用当前Teams专属标签。应检查网络/账户类型、授权及媒体规则，预览文案和裁切，并在计划时间后确认真实帖子。日历条目不等于外部发布。本研究未连接账户，也未提交帖子或草稿。

sections.en:
The normal browser monthly selector showed Starter $6/month and Pro $9/month. Selecting Annually changed the cards to $60/year and $90/year respectively; those are annual totals, not $60 or $90 every month as some flattened hidden dialogs suggest. Teams is custom pricing. Currency/tax and account-specific checkout were not verified.

Starter lists 20 GB storage, JPEG/PNG and watermark-free downloads; Pro lists 50 GB, all supported downloadable formats and multiple brand kits. The matrix shows Free JPEG and three watermark-free downloads, Starter JPEG/PNG, and Pro JPEG/PNG/PDF. SVG/GIF/PPTX and other formats marked Coming Soon are not counted as available. Free design variations are limited to three; paid cards/table advertise unlimited suggestions, which does not imply unlimited premium stock usage or unrestricted social tools.
sections.zh:
正常浏览器月付选项显示Starter每月$6、Pro每月$9；切换Annually后卡片改为每年$60和$90。这是全年总额，不是部分扁平隐藏弹窗暗示的每月$60/$90。Teams询价，币种/税费及账户实际结账未核实。

Starter列出20 GB、JPEG/PNG及无水印下载；Pro为50 GB、全部受支持下载格式及多品牌工具包。矩阵显示Free为JPEG及3次无水印下载，Starter为JPEG/PNG，Pro为JPEG/PNG/PDF。标记Coming Soon的SVG/GIF/PPTX等不计为可用。免费设计变体限3次，付费宣传无限建议，不代表高级图库无限或社交工具无条件开放。

sections.title_en: Do not reuse the old stock-credit counts
sections.en:
The current browser matrix lists premium stock credits per month as Starter 6, Pro 9 and Teams 18; Free has no included premium stock credits. The [older image-credit article](https://support.picmaker.com/en/articles/5102689-how-do-image-credits-work-in-picmaker), dated January 2022, instead describes 20/50 for Starter/Pro. Its useful mechanism is that a paid-image use consumes a credit, repeated uses can consume again and unused credits do not roll over. Its old numerical quotas are not treated as current.

For a batch, count premium-image uses separately from AI suggestions and ordinary exports, and confirm the current in-account deduction/refresh rule and per-image excess charge. “Unlimited downloads” and a large stock library do not eliminate paid-image licensing or quotas. The exact current add-on rates and whether all listed credits apply identically across media remain unverified.
sections.zh:
当前浏览器矩阵把每月高级图库点数列为Starter 6、Pro 9、Teams 18，Free不含高级图库点数。[2022年1月旧文章](https://support.picmaker.com/en/articles/5102689-how-do-image-credits-work-in-picmaker)却列Starter/Pro为20/50。其有用机制是付费图片使用消耗点数、重复使用也可再次消耗、未用点数不结转，但旧数值不当当前额度。

批量制作应把高级图片使用、AI建议及普通导出分别计算，并核对账户当前扣减/刷新规则和超额单图价。“无限下载”及大图库不取消付费图片许可或额度。当前附加价格及点数是否对全部媒体相同仍未核实。

sections.title_en: Third-party stock is restricted even in paid designs
sections.title_zh: 付费设计中的第三方图库仍受限制
sections.en:
The [August 23, 2023 terms](https://www.picmaker.com/terms-of-use) retain platform IP and grant limited personal/internal-business access. Third-party material must be used inside Picmaker-created works, not extracted as standalone stock; the terms restrict retail products, electronic templates and use in logos/trademarks/brand identifiers. A logo-making feature is not permission to trademark a licensed stock element. You remain responsible for uploaded rights.

The terms also grant Picmaker a broad license over created/submitted work; private customer artwork needs an appropriate contractual review. They state that the free plan has no disaster-recovery support or stored project version history, and monthly purchases are not refundable for the purchased month. Keep permitted local outputs and verify save/reopen behavior. Neither public-page availability nor the uptime marketing establishes a recovery guarantee. No editor, purchase, asset license clearance or recovery test was executed.
sections.zh:
[2023年8月23日条款](https://www.picmaker.com/terms-of-use)保留平台知识产权，仅授予有限个人/内部业务访问。第三方素材须用于Picmaker创作的作品，不能提取为独立图库；条款限制零售商品、电子模板，以及标志/商标/品牌识别用途。具备标志制作功能不等于允许把授权图库元素注册商标，上传权利仍由用户负责。

条款还对创作/提交作品授予Picmaker广泛许可，客户私有素材需适当合同核查。Free没有灾难恢复支持或保存的项目版本历史，月付购买当月不退款。应保留许可允许的本地输出并检查保存/重开；公开页面可访问及可用率宣传都不构成恢复保证。本研究未执行编辑器、购买、素材清权或恢复测试。
